(function () {
	var script = document.currentScript;
	var root = script && script.parentNode;
	if (!root || !root.querySelector('[data-overflow-sentinel]')) return;

	var isHydrated = false;
	root.addEventListener('navigation:menu-overflow-hydrated', function () {
		isHydrated = true;
	});

	function check() {
		if (isHydrated || root.hasAttribute('data-view')) return;
		// The skeleton and the real menu each render their own sentinel; the first one may be gone by now.
		var sentinel = root.querySelector('[data-overflow-sentinel]');
		if (!sentinel) return;
		var deficit = sentinel.getBoundingClientRect().right - sentinel.parentNode.getBoundingClientRect().right;
		if (deficit >= 1) {
			root.setAttribute('data-view', 'mobile');
			root.setAttribute('data-view-deficit', Math.ceil(deficit));
			root.setAttribute('data-view-width', window.innerWidth);
		}
	}

	check();
	var images = root.querySelectorAll('img');
	for (var i = 0; i < images.length; i++) {
		if (!images[i].complete) images[i].addEventListener('load', check, { once: true });
	}
	if (document.fonts) document.fonts.ready.then(check);
})();

	/* LAST EDIT: 23.06.2026 */

	const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
	const IS_DEBUG = urlParams.get('debug') === 'true';

	const debugLog = (message, payload) => {
		if (IS_DEBUG) console.info(message, payload);
	};
	// ============================================
	// CONSTANTS
	// ============================================
	const LOYALTY_MIDDLE_BANNER_SELECTOR = '[data-custom-id="loyalty-middle-banner"]';

	// ELEMENTS TO ANIMATE FROM THE INITIAL 0 HEIGHT AND OPACITY 0 TO VISIBLE STATE
	const ELEMENTS_WITH_HEIGHT_AND_OPACITY = [];

	function queryElements() {
		// PLEASE BE SURE THAT CORRECT CUSTOM IDS ARE SET IN CMS FOR THE HIDDEN ELEMENTS ARE ALSO USED IN STYLE ABOVE
		// REPLACE QUERIES WITH SELECTORS THAT ARE CONFIGURED, THIS IS JUST AN EXAMPLE
		ELEMENTS_WITH_HEIGHT_AND_OPACITY.push(...document.querySelectorAll(LOYALTY_MIDDLE_BANNER_SELECTOR));
	}

	function animateElementHeightAndOpacity($element, action) {
		if (!$element) return;

		if (action === 'hide') {
			if ($element.classList.contains('element-hidden')) return;

			const handleTransitionEnd = (event) => {
				if (event.target !== $element) return;

				if (event.propertyName === 'max-height' || event.propertyName === 'opacity') {
					$element.classList.add('element-hidden');

					$element.removeEventListener('transitionend', handleTransitionEnd);
				}
			};

			$element.addEventListener('transitionend', handleTransitionEnd, { once: true, passive: true });

			$element.style.maxHeight = '0';
			$element.style.opacity = '0';
			return;
		}

		$element.classList.remove('element-hidden');

		requestAnimationFrame(() => {
			$element.style.maxHeight = '1000px';
			$element.style.opacity = '1';
		});
	}

	// ============================================
	// STATE LOGIC (same as in loyalty-landing-page, keep in sync)
	// ============================================

	const AUTH_STATUS = {
		CHECKING: 'CHECKING',
		LOGGED_IN: 'LOGGED_IN',
		LOGGED_OUT: 'LOGGED_OUT',
	};

	const USER_TYPE = {
		CHECKING: 'CHECKING',
		EMPLOYEE: 'EMPLOYEE',
		NON_PARTICIPANT: 'NON_PARTICIPANT',
		PARTICIPANT_L1: 'PARTICIPANT_L1',
		PARTICIPANT_L2: 'PARTICIPANT_L2',
		PARTICIPANT_L3: 'PARTICIPANT_L3',
		PARTICIPANT_NO_LEVEL: 'PARTICIPANT_NO_LEVEL',
	};

	// Selectors - pure functions to compute derived state
	const selectParticipantLevel = (currentState) => {
		const levelMap = {
			[USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L1]: 1,
			[USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L2]: 2,
			[USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L3]: 3,
		};
		return levelMap[currentState.USER_TYPE] || null;
	};

	const selectIsAuthChecking = (currentState) => currentState.AUTH_STATUS === AUTH_STATUS.CHECKING;
	const selectIsUserTypeChecking = (currentState) => currentState.USER_TYPE === USER_TYPE.CHECKING;
	const selectIsLoggedIn = (currentState) => currentState.AUTH_STATUS === AUTH_STATUS.LOGGED_IN;
	const selectIsLoggedOut = (currentState) => currentState.AUTH_STATUS === AUTH_STATUS.LOGGED_OUT;
	const selectIsLoyaltyAvailable = (currentState) => !!currentState.USER_DATA?.loyalty?.isAvailable;
	const selectIsEmployee = (currentState) => currentState.USER_TYPE === USER_TYPE.EMPLOYEE;
	const selectIsParticipantNoLevel = (currentState) => currentState.USER_TYPE === USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_NO_LEVEL;
	const selectIsNonParticipant = (currentState) => currentState.USER_TYPE === USER_TYPE.NON_PARTICIPANT;
	const selectIsParticipant = (currentState) => selectParticipantLevel(currentState) !== null;

	function getNormalizedUserData(payload) {
		if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return null;

		const userData = payload.data && typeof payload.data === 'object' ? payload.data : payload;
		const loyaltyData = payload.loyalty || userData.loyalty;

		return {
			...userData,
			loyalty: loyaltyData
				? {
					enrolled: loyaltyData.enrolled || loyaltyData.enroled,
					isAvailable: loyaltyData.isAvailable,
					isMarketEnabled : loyaltyData.isMarketEnabled,
					isUserEligible : loyaltyData.isUserEligible,
					tier: loyaltyData.tierLevel || loyaltyData.tier || null,
				}
				: undefined,
		};
	}

	function getUserTypeFromUserData(userData) {
		if (!userData?.loyalty?.isAvailable) {
			return USER_TYPE.EMPLOYEE;
		}

		if (userData.loyalty.enrolled !== 'CONFIRMED') {
			return USER_TYPE.NON_PARTICIPANT;
		}

		const level = Number(userData.loyalty.tier);
		const levelUserTypes = {
			1: USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L1,
			2: USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L2,
			3: USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L3,
		};

		return levelUserTypes[level] || USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_NO_LEVEL;
	}

	function setLoyaltyStateFromAuthPayload(payload) {
		const userData = getNormalizedUserData(payload);
		const userType = getUserTypeFromUserData(userData);

		State.setMultiple({
			AUTH_STATUS: AUTH_STATUS.LOGGED_IN,
			USER_DATA: userData,
			USER_TYPE: userType,
		});
	}

	function createState() {
		const listeners = new Set();
		let state = {
			AUTH_STATUS: AUTH_STATUS.CHECKING,
			USER_DATA: null,
			USER_TYPE: USER_TYPE.CHECKING,
		};

		return {
			clearListeners() {
				listeners.clear();
			},
			getState() {
				return { ...state };
			},
			notify() {
				listeners.forEach((callback) => callback(state));
			},
			setState(key, value) {
				if (state[key] !== value) {
					state = { ...state, [key]: value };
					this.notify();
				}
			},
			setMultiple(updates) {
				let changed = false;
				for (const key in updates) {
					if (state[key] !== updates[key]) {
						state = { ...state, [key]: updates[key] };
						changed = true;
					}
				}
				if (changed) this.notify();
			},
			subscribe(callback) {
				listeners.add(callback);
			},
			unsubscribe(callback) {
				listeners.delete(callback);
			},
		};
	}

	const State = createState();

	function onLoginSuccessful(e) {
		debugLog('[DEBUG]: lmn:login:successful', e.detail);

		setLoyaltyStateFromAuthPayload(e.detail);
	}

	function onCheckAuthSuccessful(e) {
		debugLog('[DEBUG]: lmn:checkAuth:successful', e.detail);

		setLoyaltyStateFromAuthPayload(e.detail);
	}

	function onCheckAuthFailed(e) {
		debugLog('[DEBUG]: lmn:checkAuth:failed', e.detail);
		State.setMultiple({
			AUTH_STATUS: AUTH_STATUS.LOGGED_OUT,
			USER_DATA: null,
			USER_TYPE: USER_TYPE.NON_PARTICIPANT,
		});
	}

	function onLogout(e) {
		debugLog('[DEBUG]: lmn:logout:successful', e.detail);
		State.setMultiple({
			AUTH_STATUS: AUTH_STATUS.LOGGED_OUT,
			USER_DATA: null,
			USER_TYPE: USER_TYPE.NON_PARTICIPANT,
		});
	}


	function addAuthEventListeners() {
		window.addEventListener('lmn:checkAuth:successful', onCheckAuthSuccessful, { passive: true });
		window.addEventListener('lmn:checkAuth:failed', onCheckAuthFailed, { passive: true });
		window.addEventListener('lmn:login:successful', onLoginSuccessful, { passive: true });
		window.addEventListener('lmn:logout:successful', onLogout, { passive: true });
	}

	// ============================================
	// END STATE LOGIC (same as in loyalty-landing-page)
	// ============================================

	State.subscribe(handleElementsVisibility);

	function handleElementsVisibility(state) {
		const isAuthChecking = selectIsAuthChecking(state);
		const isUserTypeChecking = selectIsUserTypeChecking(state);
		const isParticipating = selectIsParticipant(state);
		const isLoggedOut = selectIsLoggedOut(state);
		const isLoyaltyAvailable = selectIsLoyaltyAvailable(state);
		const isLoggedIn = selectIsLoggedIn(state);

		const getVisibility = () => {
			if (isAuthChecking || isUserTypeChecking) return false;

			if (isLoggedIn) return isLoyaltyAvailable && !isParticipating;

			return isLoggedOut && !isParticipating;
		};

		const shouldShow = getVisibility();

		debugLog('[DEBUG]: handleElementsVisibility', {
			isAuthChecking,
			isLoggedOut,
			isLoyaltyAvailable,
			isParticipating,
			isUserTypeChecking,
			shouldShow,
			state,
		});

		ELEMENTS_WITH_HEIGHT_AND_OPACITY.forEach(($element) => {
			animateElementHeightAndOpacity($element, shouldShow ? 'show' : 'hide');
		});
	}


	// ============================================
	// STARTRACK
	// ============================================
	const LMN_USER_STARTRACK_INTERACTION = 'lmn:ui:startrack:interaction';

	/** IMPORTANT!!!
	 * Please be sure that the version and payload for each event type matches the schema in Startrack
	 * https://gitlab.lastminute.com/data_platform/startrack-events-schema/-/tree/master/contenthub-ui
	 */
	function sendBannerShownEvent({ bannerType, content, label, loginFlag, loyaltyTier, position, userLoyaltyEnrol }) {
		const payload = {
			name: 'BANNER_SHOWN',
			payload: {
				BANNER_TYPE: bannerType,
				CONTENT: content,
				LABEL: label,
				LOGIN_FLAG: loginFlag,
				LOYALTY_TIER: loyaltyTier,
				POSITION: position,
				USER_LOYALTY_ENROL: userLoyaltyEnrol,
			},
			version: '1.0',
		};
		dispatchStartrackEvent(payload);
	}

	function sendCtaClickEvent({ content, label, loginFlag, loyaltyTier, page, position, type, userLoyaltyEnrol }) {
		const payload = {
			name: 'CTA_CLICK',
			payload: {
				CONTENT: content,
				LABEL: label,
				LOGIN_FLAG: loginFlag,
				LOYALTY_TIER: loyaltyTier,
				PAGE: page,
				POSITION: position,
				TYPE: type,
				USER_LOYALTY_ENROL: userLoyaltyEnrol,
			},
			version: '1.0',
		};
		dispatchStartrackEvent(payload);
	}

	function dispatchStartrackEvent(payload) {
		debugLog('[DEBUG]: [STARTRACK] event:', payload);

		window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(LMN_USER_STARTRACK_INTERACTION, { detail: { payload } }));
	}

	function observeCustomElementVisibility(element, onVisible) {
		if (!element) return;

		const options = { root: null, threshold: 0.3 };

		const observerCallback = (entries, observer) => {
			entries.forEach((entry) => {
				if (entry.isIntersecting) {
					onVisible(entry.target);

					observer.unobserve(entry.target);
				}
			});
		};

		const observer = new IntersectionObserver(observerCallback, options);
		observer.observe(element);
	}

	function setMiddleBannerListeners() {
		let ctaClickSent = false;
		let bannerShownSent = false;

		// Delegate to document in capture phase so the listener fires before React's
		// root container calls nativeEvent.stopPropagation() at the end of its synthetic
		// event dispatch — bubble-phase listeners on document are blocked by React.
		document.addEventListener(
			'click',
			(event) => {
				if (ctaClickSent) return;
				if (!event.target?.closest(LOYALTY_MIDDLE_BANNER_SELECTOR + ' a')) return;
				ctaClickSent = true;

				const currentState = State.getState();
				const loginFlag = selectIsLoggedIn(currentState);

				sendCtaClickEvent({
					content: 'Sign up for free',
					label: 'sign up',
					loginFlag,
					loyaltyTier: null,
					page: 'home_page',
					position: 'mid_page_banner',
					type: 'CTA_CLICK',
					userLoyaltyEnrol: false,
				});
			},
			{ capture: true, passive: true },
		);

		// Visibility tracking needs the element — wait for it via MutationObserver
		// in case the CMS injects it after the script runs.
		function attachVisibilityObserver(banner) {
			if (bannerShownSent) return;

			observeCustomElementVisibility(banner, () => {
				if (bannerShownSent) return;
				bannerShownSent = true;

				const currentState = State.getState();
				const loginFlag = selectIsLoggedIn(currentState);

				sendBannerShownEvent({
					bannerType: 'mid_page_banner',
					content: 'Join our loyalty programme',
					label: 'loyalty',
					loginFlag,
					loyaltyTier: null,
					position: 'mid_page',
					userLoyaltyEnrol: false,
				});
			});
		}

		const existingBanner = document.querySelector(LOYALTY_MIDDLE_BANNER_SELECTOR);

		if (existingBanner) {
			attachVisibilityObserver(existingBanner);
			return;
		}

		const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
			const banner = document.querySelector(LOYALTY_MIDDLE_BANNER_SELECTOR);
			if (!banner) return;
			observer.disconnect();
			attachVisibilityObserver(banner);
		});

		observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
	}

	function prepareElements() {
		queryElements();
		ELEMENTS_WITH_HEIGHT_AND_OPACITY.forEach(($element) => {
			$element.classList.add('element-hidden');
		});
	}
	// ============================================
	// STARTRACK
	// ============================================

	prepareElements();
	addAuthEventListeners();
	setMiddleBannerListeners();

	const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
	const IS_DEBUG = urlParams.get('debug') === 'true';

	const debugLog = (message, payload) => {
		if (IS_DEBUG) console.info(message, payload);
	};
	// ============================================
	// CONSTANTS
	// ============================================
	const LOYALTY_MIDDLE_BANNER_SELECTOR = '[data-custom-id="loyalty-middle-banner"]';

	// ELEMENTS TO ANIMATE FROM THE INITIAL 0 HEIGHT AND OPACITY 0 TO VISIBLE STATE
	const ELEMENTS_WITH_HEIGHT_AND_OPACITY = [];

	function queryElements() {
		// PLEASE BE SURE THAT CORRECT CUSTOM IDS ARE SET IN CMS FOR THE HIDDEN ELEMENTS ARE ALSO USED IN STYLE ABOVE
		// REPLACE QUERIES WITH SELECTORS THAT ARE CONFIGURED, THIS IS JUST AN EXAMPLE
		ELEMENTS_WITH_HEIGHT_AND_OPACITY.push(...document.querySelectorAll(LOYALTY_MIDDLE_BANNER_SELECTOR));
	}

	function animateElementHeightAndOpacity($element, action) {
		if (!$element) return;

		if (action === 'hide') {
			if ($element.classList.contains('element-hidden')) return;

			const handleTransitionEnd = (event) => {
				if (event.target !== $element) return;

				if (event.propertyName === 'max-height' || event.propertyName === 'opacity') {
					$element.classList.add('element-hidden');

					$element.removeEventListener('transitionend', handleTransitionEnd);
				}
			};

			$element.addEventListener('transitionend', handleTransitionEnd, { once: true, passive: true });

			$element.style.maxHeight = '0';
			$element.style.opacity = '0';
			return;
		}

		$element.classList.remove('element-hidden');

		requestAnimationFrame(() => {
			$element.style.maxHeight = '1000px';
			$element.style.opacity = '1';
		});
	}

	// ============================================
	// STATE LOGIC (same as in loyalty-landing-page, keep in sync)
	// ============================================

	const AUTH_STATUS = {
		CHECKING: 'CHECKING',
		LOGGED_IN: 'LOGGED_IN',
		LOGGED_OUT: 'LOGGED_OUT',
	};

	const USER_TYPE = {
		CHECKING: 'CHECKING',
		EMPLOYEE: 'EMPLOYEE',
		NON_PARTICIPANT: 'NON_PARTICIPANT',
		PARTICIPANT_L1: 'PARTICIPANT_L1',
		PARTICIPANT_L2: 'PARTICIPANT_L2',
		PARTICIPANT_L3: 'PARTICIPANT_L3',
		PARTICIPANT_NO_LEVEL: 'PARTICIPANT_NO_LEVEL',
	};

	// Selectors - pure functions to compute derived state
	const selectParticipantLevel = (currentState) => {
		const levelMap = {
			[USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L1]: 1,
			[USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L2]: 2,
			[USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L3]: 3,
		};
		return levelMap[currentState.USER_TYPE] || null;
	};

	const selectIsAuthChecking = (currentState) => currentState.AUTH_STATUS === AUTH_STATUS.CHECKING;
	const selectIsUserTypeChecking = (currentState) => currentState.USER_TYPE === USER_TYPE.CHECKING;
	const selectIsLoggedIn = (currentState) => currentState.AUTH_STATUS === AUTH_STATUS.LOGGED_IN;
	const selectIsLoggedOut = (currentState) => currentState.AUTH_STATUS === AUTH_STATUS.LOGGED_OUT;
	const selectIsLoyaltyAvailable = (currentState) => !!currentState.USER_DATA?.loyalty?.isAvailable;
	const selectIsEmployee = (currentState) => currentState.USER_TYPE === USER_TYPE.EMPLOYEE;
	const selectIsParticipantNoLevel = (currentState) => currentState.USER_TYPE === USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_NO_LEVEL;
	const selectIsNonParticipant = (currentState) => currentState.USER_TYPE === USER_TYPE.NON_PARTICIPANT;
	const selectIsParticipant = (currentState) => selectParticipantLevel(currentState) !== null;

	function getNormalizedUserData(payload) {
		if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return null;

		const userData = payload.data && typeof payload.data === 'object' ? payload.data : payload;
		const loyaltyData = payload.loyalty || userData.loyalty;

		return {
			...userData,
			loyalty: loyaltyData
				? {
					enrolled: loyaltyData.enrolled || loyaltyData.enroled,
					isAvailable: loyaltyData.isAvailable,
					isMarketEnabled : loyaltyData.isMarketEnabled,
					isUserEligible : loyaltyData.isUserEligible,
					tier: loyaltyData.tierLevel || loyaltyData.tier || null,
				}
				: undefined,
		};
	}

	function getUserTypeFromUserData(userData) {
		if (!userData?.loyalty?.isAvailable) {
			return USER_TYPE.EMPLOYEE;
		}

		if (userData.loyalty.enrolled !== 'CONFIRMED') {
			return USER_TYPE.NON_PARTICIPANT;
		}

		const level = Number(userData.loyalty.tier);
		const levelUserTypes = {
			1: USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L1,
			2: USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L2,
			3: USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_L3,
		};

		return levelUserTypes[level] || USER_TYPE.PARTICIPANT_NO_LEVEL;
	}

	function setLoyaltyStateFromAuthPayload(payload) {
		const userData = getNormalizedUserData(payload);
		const userType = getUserTypeFromUserData(userData);

		State.setMultiple({
			AUTH_STATUS: AUTH_STATUS.LOGGED_IN,
			USER_DATA: userData,
			USER_TYPE: userType,
		});
	}

	function createState() {
		const listeners = new Set();
		let state = {
			AUTH_STATUS: AUTH_STATUS.CHECKING,
			USER_DATA: null,
			USER_TYPE: USER_TYPE.CHECKING,
		};

		return {
			clearListeners() {
				listeners.clear();
			},
			getState() {
				return { ...state };
			},
			notify() {
				listeners.forEach((callback) => callback(state));
			},
			setState(key, value) {
				if (state[key] !== value) {
					state = { ...state, [key]: value };
					this.notify();
				}
			},
			setMultiple(updates) {
				let changed = false;
				for (const key in updates) {
					if (state[key] !== updates[key]) {
						state = { ...state, [key]: updates[key] };
						changed = true;
					}
				}
				if (changed) this.notify();
			},
			subscribe(callback) {
				listeners.add(callback);
			},
			unsubscribe(callback) {
				listeners.delete(callback);
			},
		};
	}

	const State = createState();

	function onLoginSuccessful(e) {
		debugLog('[DEBUG]: lmn:login:successful', e.detail);

		setLoyaltyStateFromAuthPayload(e.detail);
	}

	function onCheckAuthSuccessful(e) {
		debugLog('[DEBUG]: lmn:checkAuth:successful', e.detail);

		setLoyaltyStateFromAuthPayload(e.detail);
	}

	function onCheckAuthFailed(e) {
		debugLog('[DEBUG]: lmn:checkAuth:failed', e.detail);
		State.setMultiple({
			AUTH_STATUS: AUTH_STATUS.LOGGED_OUT,
			USER_DATA: null,
			USER_TYPE: USER_TYPE.NON_PARTICIPANT,
		});
	}

	function onLogout(e) {
		debugLog('[DEBUG]: lmn:logout:successful', e.detail);
		State.setMultiple({
			AUTH_STATUS: AUTH_STATUS.LOGGED_OUT,
			USER_DATA: null,
			USER_TYPE: USER_TYPE.NON_PARTICIPANT,
		});
	}


	function addAuthEventListeners() {
		window.addEventListener('lmn:checkAuth:successful', onCheckAuthSuccessful, { passive: true });
		window.addEventListener('lmn:checkAuth:failed', onCheckAuthFailed, { passive: true });
		window.addEventListener('lmn:login:successful', onLoginSuccessful, { passive: true });
		window.addEventListener('lmn:logout:successful', onLogout, { passive: true });
	}

	// ============================================
	// END STATE LOGIC (same as in loyalty-landing-page)
	// ============================================

	State.subscribe(handleElementsVisibility);

	function handleElementsVisibility(state) {
		const isAuthChecking = selectIsAuthChecking(state);
		const isUserTypeChecking = selectIsUserTypeChecking(state);
		const isParticipating = selectIsParticipant(state);
		const isLoggedOut = selectIsLoggedOut(state);
		const isLoyaltyAvailable = selectIsLoyaltyAvailable(state);
		const isLoggedIn = selectIsLoggedIn(state);

		const getVisibility = () => {
			if (isAuthChecking || isUserTypeChecking) return false;

			if (isLoggedIn) return isLoyaltyAvailable && !isParticipating;

			return isLoggedOut && !isParticipating;
		};

		const shouldShow = getVisibility();

		debugLog('[DEBUG]: handleElementsVisibility', {
			isAuthChecking,
			isLoggedOut,
			isLoyaltyAvailable,
			isParticipating,
			isUserTypeChecking,
			shouldShow,
			state,
		});

		ELEMENTS_WITH_HEIGHT_AND_OPACITY.forEach(($element) => {
			animateElementHeightAndOpacity($element, shouldShow ? 'show' : 'hide');
		});
	}


	// ============================================
	// STARTRACK
	// ============================================
	const LMN_USER_STARTRACK_INTERACTION = 'lmn:ui:startrack:interaction';

	/** IMPORTANT!!!
	 * Please be sure that the version and payload for each event type matches the schema in Startrack
	 * https://gitlab.lastminute.com/data_platform/startrack-events-schema/-/tree/master/contenthub-ui
	 */
	function sendBannerShownEvent({ bannerType, content, label, loginFlag, loyaltyTier, position, userLoyaltyEnrol }) {
		const payload = {
			name: 'BANNER_SHOWN',
			payload: {
				BANNER_TYPE: bannerType,
				CONTENT: content,
				LABEL: label,
				LOGIN_FLAG: loginFlag,
				LOYALTY_TIER: loyaltyTier,
				POSITION: position,
				USER_LOYALTY_ENROL: userLoyaltyEnrol,
			},
			version: '1.0',
		};
		dispatchStartrackEvent(payload);
	}

	function sendCtaClickEvent({ content, label, loginFlag, loyaltyTier, page, position, type, userLoyaltyEnrol }) {
		const payload = {
			name: 'CTA_CLICK',
			payload: {
				CONTENT: content,
				LABEL: label,
				LOGIN_FLAG: loginFlag,
				LOYALTY_TIER: loyaltyTier,
				PAGE: page,
				POSITION: position,
				TYPE: type,
				USER_LOYALTY_ENROL: userLoyaltyEnrol,
			},
			version: '1.0',
		};
		dispatchStartrackEvent(payload);
	}

	function dispatchStartrackEvent(payload) {
		debugLog('[DEBUG]: [STARTRACK] event:', payload);

		window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(LMN_USER_STARTRACK_INTERACTION, { detail: { payload } }));
	}

	function observeCustomElementVisibility(element, onVisible) {
		if (!element) return;

		const options = { root: null, threshold: 0.3 };

		const observerCallback = (entries, observer) => {
			entries.forEach((entry) => {
				if (entry.isIntersecting) {
					onVisible(entry.target);

					observer.unobserve(entry.target);
				}
			});
		};

		const observer = new IntersectionObserver(observerCallback, options);
		observer.observe(element);
	}

	function setMiddleBannerListeners() {
		let ctaClickSent = false;
		let bannerShownSent = false;

		// Delegate to document in capture phase so the listener fires before React's
		// root container calls nativeEvent.stopPropagation() at the end of its synthetic
		// event dispatch — bubble-phase listeners on document are blocked by React.
		document.addEventListener(
			'click',
			(event) => {
				if (ctaClickSent) return;
				if (!event.target?.closest(LOYALTY_MIDDLE_BANNER_SELECTOR + ' a')) return;
				ctaClickSent = true;

				const currentState = State.getState();
				const loginFlag = selectIsLoggedIn(currentState);

				sendCtaClickEvent({
					content: 'Sign up for free',
					label: 'sign up',
					loginFlag,
					loyaltyTier: null,
					page: 'home_page',
					position: 'mid_page_banner',
					type: 'CTA_CLICK',
					userLoyaltyEnrol: false,
				});
			},
			{ capture: true, passive: true },
		);

		// Visibility tracking needs the element — wait for it via MutationObserver
		// in case the CMS injects it after the script runs.
		function attachVisibilityObserver(banner) {
			if (bannerShownSent) return;

			observeCustomElementVisibility(banner, () => {
				if (bannerShownSent) return;
				bannerShownSent = true;

				const currentState = State.getState();
				const loginFlag = selectIsLoggedIn(currentState);

				sendBannerShownEvent({
					bannerType: 'mid_page_banner',
					content: 'Join our loyalty programme',
					label: 'loyalty',
					loginFlag,
					loyaltyTier: null,
					position: 'mid_page',
					userLoyaltyEnrol: false,
				});
			});
		}

		const existingBanner = document.querySelector(LOYALTY_MIDDLE_BANNER_SELECTOR);

		if (existingBanner) {
			attachVisibilityObserver(existingBanner);
			return;
		}

		const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
			const banner = document.querySelector(LOYALTY_MIDDLE_BANNER_SELECTOR);
			if (!banner) return;
			observer.disconnect();
			attachVisibilityObserver(banner);
		});

		observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
	}

	function prepareElements() {
		queryElements();
		ELEMENTS_WITH_HEIGHT_AND_OPACITY.forEach(($element) => {
			$element.classList.add('element-hidden');
		});
	}
	// ============================================
	// STARTRACK
	// ============================================

	prepareElements();
	addAuthEventListeners();
	setMiddleBannerListeners();

|       "const SIGNAL_STATS_ENDPOINT =
  "https://secure.lastminute.com/cia-be/api/v1/signal/stats";

const TAB_ID_MAP = {
  HOTELS: "tab-hotels",
  FLIGHTS: "tab-flights",
  CITY_BREAK: "tab-city-breaks",
};

const loadPersonalisationStats = async (mpt) => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(SIGNAL_STATS_ENDPOINT, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ mpt }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      console.warn("Cannot retrieve personalisation stats");
      return;
    }

    return response.json();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Cannot retrieve personalisation stats", error);
  }
};

const openWinnerTab = (winner) => {
  const tabId = TAB_ID_MAP[winner];
  if (!tabId) return;

  const tabsWrappers = document.querySelectorAll(".tabs-wrapper");

  tabsWrappers.forEach((tabWrapper) => {
    const tab = tabWrapper.querySelector(`#${tabId}`);
    if (tab) tab.click();
  });
};

const getPersonalisationWinner = (stats) => {
  if (!stats?.counts) return;
  const { hotel, flight } = stats.counts;

  if (hotel > flight) return "HOTELS";
  if (flight > hotel) return "FLIGHTS";
  return "CITY_BREAK";
};

const isEmployee = () => {
  const userRoleOnDomain = window.lmnSession?.data?.properties?.userRoleOnDomain;
  return userRoleOnDomain === "EMPLOYEE";
}

const init = () => {
  const mpt = window.lmnSession?.data?.mpt;
  if (!mpt || !isEmployee()) return;

  loadPersonalisationStats(mpt).then((stats) => {
    const winner = getPersonalisationWinner(stats);
    openWinnerTab(winner);
  });
};


if (window.lmnSession?.data?.mpt) {
  init();
} else {
  window.addEventListener("casper-loaded", () => {
    init();
  }, { passive: true, once: true });
